prompt: Which regions beat their sales target in fiscal year 2025?
sql:
SELECT 
  "R"."RGN_NM" AS "REGION_NAME",
  SUM("S"."REVENUE") AS "ACTUAL_REVENUE",
  "T"."TGT_AMT" AS "TARGET_AMOUNT"
FROM 
  "NL2SQL_LAB"."SALES_V" "S"
  JOIN "NL2SQL_LAB"."CUST_MST" "C" ON "S"."CUSTOMER_NO" = "C"."CUST_NO"
  JOIN "NL2SQL_LAB"."RGN_MST" "R" ON "C"."RGN_CD" = "R"."RGN_CD"
  JOIN "NL2SQL_LAB"."SLS_TGT" "T" ON "C"."RGN_CD" = "T"."RGN_CD" AND "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = "T"."FISC_YR"

  UPPER("S"."FISCAL_YEAR") = UPPER('FY2025')
GROUP BY 
  "R"."RGN_NM",
  "T"."TGT_AMT"
HAVING 
  SUM("S"."REVENUE") > "T"."TGT_AMT"
ORDER BY 
  "R"."RGN_NM"

prompt: Which 5 customers grew their revenue the most from fiscal year 2024 to fiscal year 2025?
sql:
SELECT 
  "C"."CUST_NM" AS "CUSTOMER_NAME",
  SUM(CASE WHEN "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2024' THEN "S"."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) AS "REVENUE_2024",
  SUM(CASE WHEN "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2025' THEN "S"."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) AS "REVENUE_2025",
  (SUM(CASE WHEN "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2025' THEN "S"."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) - 
   SUM(CASE WHEN "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2024' THEN "S"."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END)) AS "REVENUE_GROWTH"
FROM 
  "NL2SQL_LAB"."SALES_V" "S"
JOIN 
  "NL2SQL_LAB"."CUST_MST" "C" ON "S"."CUSTOMER_NO" = "C"."CUST_NO"
WHERE 
  "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" IN ('FY2024', 'FY2025')
GROUP BY 
  "C"."CUST_NM"
HAVING 
  SUM(CASE WHEN "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2024' THEN "S"."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY 
  "REVENUE_GROWTH" DESC
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

  SUM(CASE WHEN s."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2025' THEN s."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) AS "FY2025_Revenue",
  (SUM(CASE WHEN s."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2025' THEN s."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) - 
   SUM(CASE WHEN s."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2024' THEN s."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END)) AS "Revenue_Growth"
FROM "NL2SQL_LAB"."SALES_V" s
JOIN "NL2SQL_LAB"."CUST_MST" c ON s."CUSTOMER_NO" = c."CUST_NO"
WHERE s."FISCAL_YEAR" IN ('FY2024', 'FY2025')
GROUP BY c."CUST_NM"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN s."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2024' THEN s."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY "Revenue_Growth" DESC
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

prompt: Which regions beat their sales target in fiscal year 2025?

    s."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2025'
GROUP BY 
    r."RGN_NM", t."TGT_AMT"
HAVING 
    SUM(s."REVENUE") > t."TGT_AMT"

    r."RGN_NM"

prompt: Which 5 customers grew their revenue the most from fiscal year 2024 to fiscal year 2025?
sql:
SELECT "C"."CUST_NM" AS "CUSTOMER_NAME",
       SUM(CASE WHEN "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2024' THEN "S"."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) AS "REVENUE_FY2024",
       SUM(CASE WHEN "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2025' THEN "S"."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) AS "REVENUE_FY2025",
       (SUM(CASE WHEN "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2025' THEN "S"."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2024' THEN "S"."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END)) AS "REVENUE_GROWTH"
FROM "NL2SQL_LAB"."SALES_V" "S"
JOIN "NL2SQL_LAB"."CUST_MST" "C" ON "S"."CUSTOMER_NO" = "C"."CUST_NO"
WHERE "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" IN ('FY2024', 'FY2025')
GROUP BY "C"."CUST_NM"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN "S"."FISCAL_YEAR" = 'FY2024' THEN "S"."REVENUE" ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY "REVENUE_GROWTH" DESC
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
